messages:
matt.h: Heads up — saw a spike of DCGM ECC/Xid alerts in us-west2 last night, but most were single-sample blips. Thinking we should move away from per-sample thresholds to a percentile + age-weighted approach to cut noise and prioritize older cards for drains.

sara.k: Can you share what 'percentile' means here? We currently alert on `increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m]) > 0` with a `for: 10m` which catches many short blips.

matt.h: Example POC rule:
```
- alert: GPU_ECC_Error_Rate_95th
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m])) by (le, gpu)) > 0.001
  for: 15m
```
This focuses on the tail across GPUs in a node rather than any single micro-spike. Also a recording rule: `gpu_ecc_5m_rate` so dashboards don't recompute.

jeff.r: Nice. What about repeated flappers? We should escalate only if sustained or frequency of events per card increases.

matt.h: Agreed — we can add a derived counter: `increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[1h])` and only transition to P1 if that crosses a threshold OR if the card_age > 180 (days). We have `gpu_card_age_days` in inventory labels.

infra-bot: [alert summary] 22 ECC alerts in us-west2 between 02:10-03:00 UTC. 18 resolved by auto-backoff. All nodes passed health check after soft-restart.

carla: Linking the triage playbook: <https://redwood.internal/playbooks/gpu-triage>. If we reduce noise we must ensure oncall can still find true positives quickly. Maybe add a `severity` label computed by rule.

sara.k: Rollout plan? Small canary: enable in us-west2-c then monitor false-positive rate vs ticket count for 48h.

jeff.r: Also add a metric to track how many node drains result from alerts vs manual triage — helps measure cost.

matt.h: I'll open PR with rules + recording rules + dashboard diffs. PR: #4312 (draft). Target canary by tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Need thumbs from oncall and infra.

oncall-rotation: FYI will be on duty tomorrow, will watch. If we get escalations please tag me.

sara.k: +1. One more: make sure Prometheus retention doesn't make quantiles noisy — use 5m scrape window and keep raw counters for 7d.

matt.h: Good call. Also adding exponential backoff for paging via Alertmanager grouping: `group_interval: 30m`, `repeat_interval: 6h` for non-escalating alerts.

jeff.r: Sounds solid. After canary, if false positives drop >60% we flip the rule org-wide.

matt.h: Cool. I'll paste the PR diff in here when ready.

infra-bot: PR opened by matt.h: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/ops/merge_requests/4312 — contains new rules, recording rules, and Grafana panels.

carla: Reviewed briefly — left comments about label usage. Will do a deeper review after you push tests.

matt.h: pushing tests now. Thanks!
